comment: Kiln's built-in Impact natives, registered by kiln.abilities (docs/kiln/services/abilities.md). Mod id 'kiln' is reserved. hash = FNV-1a-32 of the name. Agreed with abilities-runtime on 2026-11-04.

natives.name: kiln.Log
natives.doc: Writes one kiln.log line with the program id, impact id, self entity, site and args[0]: a variable logged by its type (uint32/sint32/float32/bool/Time, ecs.EntityId as an entity, float3, other sizes as hex up to 64 bytes) or a raw integer. Errors (>= 4) only on a bad handle.

args.name: value
args.doc: a variable handle of any type, or a raw integer

natives.name: kiln.Signal
natives.doc: Posts ImpactSignalEvent { Tag, Value (typed), ImpactId, Program, Self, Root, Site } to managed mods in the next Pre. A drop-in for triggerNoise's arity (argc 2).

args.name: value
args.doc: a variable handle (its type hash and up to 64 bytes are copied) or a raw u32

args.name: tag
args.doc: a raw u32, or a handle to a uint32/sint32 variable
